searchText: Hi Mario, for the final presentation, are we presenting by team or individually i.e it doesn't matter if you worked with a group of people on your project, each person in the group still has to present? Presentation are per project. So if you worked on a project directly together, please make a joint presentation where each of you explains your part of the work Recording from yesterday's last Office Hours AMA is up! It was a fun one https://youtu.be/mfhxeZC6Y8E Also for those who cannot make it in person to Devcon, please sing up under the issue to present next week https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-seven/issues/490
